children: Incyte Corporation (NASDAQ:INCY) reported positive proof‑of‑concept and Phase III data across MPNs, solid tumors and dermatology, closed the Vega Therapeutics deal to add latarcibart, and outlined plans to grow post‑2029 while expecting JAKAFI XR formulary uptake and potential zilurgisertib milestones.
Incyte Reports POC And Phase III Data
: Incyte (INCY) reported proof‑of‑concept and Phase III data across MPNs, solid tumors and dermatology, and outlined regulatory and commercial plans to support growth beyond 2029.
Incyte Expects JAKAFI XR Formulary Reach
: Incyte (INCY) expects JAKAFI XR to reach 70%–80% formulary coverage by year-end; forecasts 10%–30% of JAKAFI patients converting, preserving about $750M in sales during the switch.
Incyte May Earn Milestones For Zilurgisertib
: Incyte (INCY) may receive milestone payments and royalties if FDA approves zilurgisertib by Sept. 26; decision could come earlier and would allow Mirum to commercialize the drug.
: Incyte (INCY) closed acquisition of Vega Therapeutics to add latarcibart, a late‑stage von Willebrand disease candidate, advancing its strategy to buy de‑risked assets and deploy capital.
